summary: Phase 7 regression testing completed - All backend APIs (22/22) and frontend flows working. Verified PDF engine (11 doc_types, render PDF+HTML), E-Sign end-to-end (request/verify/public), WhatsApp simulation, and DocumentActionsBar integration across 3 modules (Transfer, Cycle Count, AR Receipt). CRITICAL FIX VERIFIED: autoCheckSignature=false prevents N+1 queries on list load, loadSignature(force) correctly updates badge after signing.
passed_tests: Backend: Auth login returns 'token' field (not access_token)
Backend: GET /api/pdf/doc-types returns 11 doc_types including transfer, cycle_count, ar_receipt
Backend: PDF render (format=pdf) returns valid PDF with %PDF header for transfer/cycle_count/ar_receipt
Backend: HTML render (format=html) returns valid HTML for transfer/cycle_count/ar_receipt
Backend: E-Sign request OTP returns request_id + reveal_code (simulation mode)
Backend: E-Sign verify returns verification_code + doc_hash (SHA-256)
Backend: E-Sign public verify (no auth) returns valid:true
Backend: E-Sign get signatures returns signature list
Backend: WhatsApp recipient resolution returns phone field
Backend: WhatsApp send returns status 'simulated' (by design)
Frontend: Login flow working (proven recipe: wait 2.5s, fill, click Masuk, wait 5s)
Frontend: Transfer module - DocumentActionsBar with preview/download/wa buttons (NO esign, esignable=false)
Frontend: Transfer - Preview iframe loads successfully
Frontend: Cycle Count module - DocumentActionsBar with correct buttons (NO esign)
Frontend: AR Receipt - autoCheckSignature=false working (badge count stable on list load, no N+1 queries)
Frontend: AR Receipt - E-Sign flow complete (draw signature, OTP auto-fill, verify, get code)
Frontend: AR Receipt - loadSignature(force) working (badge count increased from 0 to 1 after signing)
Frontend: WhatsApp modal - Phone auto-filled, simulation mode indicator present
Frontend: Public verification page - Shows valid signature without login

additional_notes.environment: Fresh clone, deps installed, DB re-seeded (seed_realistic.py), FE rebuilt (main.b9c09f79.js), Phase 7 gate.sh GREEN 12/12
mocked_apis: WhatsApp send: status 'simulated' (no Meta credential) - by design
E-Sign OTP: channel 'simulated', code via 'reveal_code' - by design
additional_notes.critical_fix_verified: autoCheckSignature=false in ARReceiptsHistory.jsx prevents N+1 signature fetch on list load. loadSignature(force) in DocumentActionsBar.jsx correctly updates badge after user signs document. Badge count increased from 0 to 1 after signing, confirming fix works as designed.
